currency_decision.summary: TASK BRIEF SAID JPY; SOURCE SAYS SGD FOR THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. The audited consolidated financial statements of DHLT (Statement of Comprehensive Income p146, SFP p145, Cash Flows p149, Statement of Portfolio p150, all notes) are PRESENTED IN SINGAPORE DOLLARS (S$'000). Per the §0 invariant 'extract what the report says, never assume', financial.json / performance.json / property market_valuation are all in SGD absolute. Only per-property operating figures (NPI, gross revenue, purchase price, card valuation) are in JPY millions (Japan) / VND millions (Vietnam) and are kept native with per-figure currency fields. No conversion applied anywhere. The prior-year 'DHLU JPY NPI' Tier-0 bug referred to per-property NPI scale (JPY millions), which here is stored as absolute JPY (x1,000,000) with net_property_income_currency=JPY.
currency_decision.npi_scale_confirmation: Consolidated NPI = S$43,890k (S$'000 x1000 = 43,890,000 absolute SGD). Per-property Japan NPI in JPY millions (sum 4,838 JPY million = Japan Portfolio NPI, verified vs bar chart p24). NO thousands/millions mis-scale.

reconciliation.valuation_note: Sum of 18 properties from Statement of Portfolio (p150) = S$835,902k. Headline marketing figure S$835.9m. Match confirmed. SFP investment properties line S$996,406k = valuation 835,902 + ROU assets 144,001 + ARO 16,503 (per reconciliation box p150).
reconciliation.gross_revenue_components: Rental income S$50,535k + Recoverable and other income S$6,565k = S$57,100k (note 18 p176).
reconciliation.npi_currency_basis: JPY millions - Japan Portfolio NPI (17 properties): 534+554+258+128+164+186+118+240+184+1231+291+205+303+165+121+53+103 = 4,838 JPY million (matches reported Japan NPI JPY 4,838m, bar chart p24). Vietnam property NPI VND 22,239m stored separately. SGD per-property reconciliation not applicable (cross-currency portfolio); gate skips JPY/VND rows.
reconciliation.gross_revenue_currency_basis: JPY millions - 7 multi-tenanted Japan properties disclosed: 787+747+335+1,752+402+376+152 = 4,551 JPY million. 11 single-tenant properties have null gross_revenue (structural, note 3 p26). Vietnam GR not disclosed per property (segment GR S$1,225k, note 24 p179).

columns_never_fillable.reason: DHLT is a logistics/industrial REIT reporting NLA (sqm) only. GLA not disclosed for any property.

Note 3 p26: gross rental income not disclosed for single-tenanted properties due to confidentiality obligations. Affects 11 single-tenant properties (Nagano Suzaka, Maebashi, Kuki, Ibaraki Yuki, Misato, Iruma, Kakegawa, Okayama Hayashima 2, Matsuyama, Fukuoka Tobara, Tan Duc 2). Disclosed only for 7 multi-tenanted properties (in JPY millions).

Per-property NPI/GR disclosed in local currency (JPY millions for Japan; VND millions for Tan Duc 2), p27. Consolidated income statement translates at average FX not disclosed per-property. No per-property SGD figure published; fields carry native-currency absolute values with *_currency fields. Excluded from SGD gate reconciliation.

parsing_traps.description: DHLT's audited consolidated financial statements are in S$'000 (SGD). Task brief assumed JPY. Only underlying property operations are JPY/VND. See currency_decision.

parsing_traps.trap: pct_basis for top tenants is NPI not GRI
parsing_traps.description: Top 10 Tenant table (p48) uses % of NPI (footnote 6), while trade-mix (p48) uses % of GRI (footnote 3). Kept distinct: top_tenants pct_basis=npi, trade_mix pct_basis=gri.

parsing_traps.trap: SFP investment properties line != Statement-of-Portfolio valuation
parsing_traps.description: SFP 'Investment properties' S$996,406k includes IFRS-16 right-of-use assets (S$144,001k) and Asset Retirement Obligation (S$16,503k). market_valuation uses 'Investment properties, at valuation' S$835,902k (Statement of Portfolio reconciliation p150), NOT the SFP line.
